Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to modifying Washington state excise tax laws to create jobs and to preserve funding for education, public safety, health care, and safety net services for elderly, disabled, and vulnerable people.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying Washington state excise tax laws tocreate jobs and to preserve funding for education, public safety,health care, and safety net services for elderly, disabled, andvulnerable people.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act shall be known and cited as themodifying Washington state excise tax laws to create jobs and topreserve funding for education, public safety, health care, and safetynet services for elderly, disabled, and vulnerable people act of 2010.
